listen.title: Answers on
listen.description: loopback (the default) answers only processes on this Server, such as its Grafana; management answers on the Server's management address. VictoriaMetrics has no login: anyone who reaches it can read and write every series.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long samples are kept: a whole number with d (days), w (weeks), M (months), or y (years), at most 100 years. Leave blank for VictoriaMetrics's default, 1M.

hooks.name: software
hooks.reason: Bounds the retention, records the pinned release with the listen address and retention defaults, and passes the port the playbook binds; the catalog entry travels with it.
